_about: Data of the lena_bedroom set (Lena's bedroom in an old house at night (bed, bedside lamp, window with a dying plant, door)), light preset warmInterior. Made by tools/new_set.py from the indoor base. Read by tools/build_props.py (marks, front), src/world/sets/LenaBedroom.tsx (room), tools/set_review.py (review). Marks = feet positions (m). The room is closed (4 walls); the cameras sit inside it, usually on the +z side looking to -z.

lights.sitter: someone sits up in bed at mark bed (1 = lap mound + legs under the blanket, default; 0 = empty bed)

_camera_bounds: box the camera must stay inside (walls, ceiling); presets shorten their distance to fit

review._about: tools/set_review.py: sun = the locked warmInterior key light, shadow_size = its locked box; the sweep's center/radius; points = the room's top corners (add big furniture)
